run_dfs_on_graph: run depth-first search on a directed or undirected graph adjacency matrix
run_bfs_on_graph: run breadth-first search from a source node on a graph adjacency matrix
run_topological_sort: run topological sort on a directed acyclic graph adjacency matrix
run_bipartite_matching: run Edmonds-Karp bipartite matching on a bipartite graph adjacency matrix
run_shortest_path_algorithms: run dijkstra bellman-ford or floyd-warshall shortest path on a weighted graph adjacency matrix
